verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right flow (brand, then details, then product, then CTA) and keeps the product can at a readable size. But the 'Sunset Sessions' headline is squeezed inside the circle and nearly touches the '6:00 pm' copy, the RSVP button sits in a ragged grid with badges of mismatched size, and the legal text and the missing-asset box are unreadably small. B gives the headline more weight, but its right half is badly crammed: 'Saturday 21 June' wraps into an orphaned 'June', the time and venue text is squeezed into a narrow column, the RSVP button and badges are packed tightly together, the product can is shrunk and jammed against the right edge, and the legal text is tiny. Meanwhile the left side has a lot of dead space and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' floats on its own.
